stories.title: Dodgers Drop Seventh Straight — Waldschmidt Walk-Off, Longest Skid Since 2017

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
The Dodgers have lost SEVEN straight games.

Waldschmidt's walk-off 2-run homer off Díaz gave Arizona a 4-3 win last night.

Last time LA dropped 7 in a row: 2017. Ohtani not throwing. Snell returns Aug. 11.

#BallparkBanter #Dodgers #MLB

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Most expensive roster in baseball. Seven-game losing streak.

The Dodgers have Skubal, a returning Snell, and an Ohtani who can't throw yet.

August is supposed to be their warm-up. It hasn't felt like one. 🔵

#BallparkBanter #Dodgers #Baseball

Olson hit No. 33, streak now 898. Mahle debuted. Yankees 3, Braves 2. ⚾
